title: Hidden in Plain Sight: The Overlooked Significance of Canonical Elements for Extreme LLM Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2609.06557v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often considered fragile under aggressive sparsification, and maintaining reliable performance typically requires sticking to moderate sparsity levels. However, recent studies suggest that LLMs are more resilient to high sparsity than previously thought, reframing the problem as a design challenge rather than a fundamental limitation. In this work, we challenge the perceived limits of unstructured post-training LLM pruning by revisiting elementary pruning strategies that have remained relatively underexplored at this scale. Through a progressive sparsification framework with second-order saliency and continued training coordinated with sparsity progression, we show that pretrained LLMs can retain strong performance far beyond commonly studied sparsity regimes. translated_title: 藏在明处：被忽视的规范元素对大语言模型极端稀疏化的重要意义
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）通常被认为在激进稀疏化下非常脆弱，维持可靠性能通常需要将稀疏度保持在适度水平。然而，近期研究表明，LLMs对高稀疏度的适应能力比以往认为的更强，这将该问题重新定义为一个设计挑战而非根本性限制。在这项工作中，我们通过重新审视在此规模下相对未被充分探索的基础剪枝策略，来挑战非结构化训练后LLM剪枝的公认极限。通过一个结合二阶显著性度量与稀疏化进程相协调的持续训练的渐进稀疏化框架，我们证明预训练的LLMs可以在远超常见研究范围的稀疏度下保持强大性能。在LLaMA-2和Qwen-3模型系列上，我们的方法在高达99%的稀疏度下提升了困惑度和下游准确率，超越了当前最先进的…
tldr: 该研究提出结合二阶显著性与持续训练的渐进稀疏化框架，通过重新审视基础剪枝策略中的规范元素，证明预训练大语言模型在高达99%的极端稀疏度下仍能保持强大性能，突破了非结构化训练后剪枝的公认极限。
en_tdlr: By revisiting overlooked canonical pruning elements within a progressive sparsification framework combining second-order saliency and continued training, this work demonstrates that pretrained LLMs can retain strong performance at up to 99% sparsity, challenging the perceived limits of unstructured post-training pruning.
